Error.description: Error response returned when the request is unsuccessful.

code.description: An error code that identifies the type of error that occurred.

details.description: Additional details that can help the caller understand or fix the issue.

message.description: A message that describes the error condition.

ErrorList.description: A list of error responses returned when a request is unsuccessful.

Link.description: A link to resources related to a listing restriction.

resource.description: The URI of the related resource.

title.description: The title of the related resource.

type.description: The media type of the related resource.

verb.description: The HTTP verb used to interact with the related resource.

Reason.description: A reason for the restriction, including path forward links that may allow Selling Partners to remove the restriction, if available.

links.description: A list of path forward links that may allow Selling Partners to remove the restriction.

message.description: A message describing the reason for the restriction.

reasonCode.description: A code indicating why the listing is restricted.

Restriction.description: A listing restriction, optionally qualified by a condition, with a list of reasons for the restriction.

conditionType.description: The condition that applies to the restriction.

reasons.description: A list of reasons for the restriction.

RestrictionList.description: A list of restrictions for the specified Amazon catalog item.
